title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT)
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh;
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th October, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS:1/(34)2001, dated
27-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed always to have taken effect from 14th August, 2001.

2. Amendment of section 2 of
Sindh Ordinance XXVII of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance,
2001, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, after clause
(xxvii), the following new clause (xxvii-a) shall be inserted:--
"(xxvii-a) Provincial

nominated for the purpose;".

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 119 of 8indh Ordinance XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT)
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh;
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th October, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS:1/(34)2001, dated
27-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
10. Amendment of section 119
of 8indh Ordinance XXVII of 2001.- In the said Ordinance, in section 119--
(i)
the existing subsection (1) shall be renumbered as (1-A) and before subsection (1-A) the following new subsection
shall be inserted--
"(1)
the respective local Government shall prescribe the classification of schemes to be undertaken exclusively under
the provisions of this section.";
(ii)
in the (renumbered) subsection (1-A) for the words "fifty percent."
the words "eighty
percent." shall be substituted;
(iii)
in the (renumbered) subsection (2), for the words and figure subsection (1), the words and the figure subsection
(1-A) shall be substituted;
(iv)
for subsection (3), the following shall be substituted:--
"(3) A cut-off date before
the presentation of the budget, shall be announced by each local Government for
registration of all scheme proposed by Citizen Community Board.";
(v) the subsection (7) shall be
re-worded as follows:--
"(7) The statement referred
to in subsection (6) shall be approved by simple majority of the Zila Council,
Taluka Council, Town Council or Union Council, as the case may be in special
session to be held by the respective council."; and
(vi) after the subsection (8), a
new subsection (9), shall be added as follows:--
"(9) The District Accounts
Officer of the concerned District shall release funds from the District and
'Taluka or Town Provincial Accounts according to the schedule of expenditure as
passed by the respective council under subsection (8) subject to subsection
(12) of section 109."

"(1-A). Where local council
has been validly constituted under subsection (1), but seats of Nazim and Naib
Nazim of the corresponding level have not been filled, the concerned council
shall elect officiating Nazim and Naib Nazim from amongst its members until
their seats are filled through bye-election. ".
